column2: This whole thing is a work in progress, so expect some ugliness =P
To search for levels use the green "Search" sheet at the bottom
If you would like to contribute by tagging levels, that would be on the cyan "Tagging" sheets
If you would like to contribute in any other way, like helping make this whole thing prettier, or work better, let me know!
If you have any questions, suggestions, or anything else, feel free to let me (Maxter Max) know! (My dm's are open)
Tracks are ordered by newest to oldest (officials at the bottom) by default
So if a map is new, and its not near the top, then the list probably hasn't been updated to include it yet

column3: The type of gameplay that is a core identity of the map. Rather subjective, minor sections may not warrant a tag
Normal Distance gameplay, jumps, transfers, some obstacles, basically anything from the campaign
Sections that expect gripflight to clear
Sections that intend on the user flying with wings
Road contains no jumps/transfers
Saw boosts, Bomb boosts, weird physics, etc
A focus on car control
Upside down "boating" sections
A main focus on transfers
Map requires little input to complete, so little to no turns, just hold gas

The visual style or thematic design of the track, probably better to add a tag if unsure a map qualifies as it will be easier to make a judgement later when comparing it to other maps with the same tag
Advanced or annoying mechanics that the wr route utilizes. Current wr doesn't necessarily use all tricks, nor are they specifically required to be competitive
None of the following (to show it was assessed rather than simply untagged)
Getting launched by a saw or grinder
To denote levels where the wr has been Wheelie boosted
Touching a car tire to a surface to refresh blue thrusters without full landing
Usually a thing on levels without thrusters where there is an element of luck or precision to landing smoothly (both jumps in COAT skip as an example)
Launching the car with a bomb
Bug that Resets the car to it's last spawn point
Slicing the car, usually with a laser, to allow it to fit somewhere a full car wouldn't (Credit card skip, etc)
Level has been updated rendering the strat/route the wr uses impossible
Which car abilities you have at your disposal, usually at the start of the map, or for the large majority
Maps where the abilities you have access to change throughout the track. Think adventure campaign with it's corruption zones.
Levels where the overheat mechanic is disabled so you can boost infinitely without exploding
Other track features that change up gameplay without necessarily changing the driving style
Map has none of the tagged features
Teleporters exist within the level (and thus routing may be more complicated than simply taking the most direct path from start to finish)
Hidden alternate routes or hidden portals
Boost pads or power ups that increase the cars speed
Must collect a number of items to complete the map
Checkpoints Required
Zones that give speed to the car similar to Boosters, though generally the size of the track or detrimental in nature
Secrets, Easter Eggs, etc
Multilap tracks
Multiple tracks that are different, not just split symmetrical roads
Maps with notable animations
Map has grind rails
Some form of locked or forced camera perspective
Level adds some form of visual distortion to the camera, usually with some kind of impact on driving clarity
Drive over it, get launched
Force Zones
Level features changing gravity
Driving across moving objects
Little to no chance of death, minimal jumping required
Minimal transfers, some obstacles. Chroma and the other early arcade (Turbines?)
Standard Distance? End of adventure campaign / 3rd campaign?
Campaign 2?
Entry level of advanced mechanics like gripflight. Zenith, Inferno, etc
Refined advanced skills, 200% arcade? (Maybe Macro as exception?), Worthy achievement? Levels ~2~10 Pred air control playlist?
Precise advanced mechanics. Upper-Mid tier Preds air control Playlist? like Toothpicks, Augur? Levels ~11~20 Pred air control playlist?
If you can't beat levels of the previous tier, then you can't rate anything this high difficulty =P Levels 21+ Pred air control playlist?
Super clear
Not sure where I am landing
Do I go up? down? around?
Where am I? Where is the road? Where is anything?
